turns.replyText:
Bonjour,

I’m sorry that one item arrived damaged. Please report it promptly using the Tediber contact form and include:

a clear description of the damage;
photos or a video of the item and its packaging;
any reservations you made on the delivery note.

Damage noticed upon delivery must be reported within 5 calendar days of receipt. Transport-related claims must be submitted within 72 hours. Please keep the item and its packaging until the case has been reviewed.

turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail: For a damaged item, the return fees for a change of mind do not apply. The return cost depends on the country of delivery. Which country was the order delivered to? Please wait for the return instructions before sending the item back.

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail:
There is no fixed replacement turnaround before the damage has been reviewed. If a replacement is approved, the damaged item is collected and the new one is delivered during the same appointment slot proposed by customer service.

Please submit the photos, description of the damage, order number, product concerned, and delivery date so the case can be reviewed.

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
If more than one item is damaged, include every affected item in the same report. List each item separately and attach clear photos or a video showing the damage and packaging for each one. Please also include your order number, delivery date, and any reservations noted on the delivery document.

Do not send the items back as a normal return before the damage has been reviewed. The appropriate solution is determined after assessing the reported items.

turns.q: Can I keep the damaged item or must I ship it back?
turns.replyTail: Please don’t ship the damaged item back as a normal return yet. Submit the photos, description, order number, and delivery date first, then wait for the return instructions after the damage has been reviewed. Whether the item needs to be returned depends on the outcome of that review.

turns.q: What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail:
If the replacement also arrives damaged, report it as a new delivery issue as soon as possible through the Tediber contact form. Include clear photos or a video of the replacement and its packaging, a description of the damage, and any reservations noted on the delivery document.

Delivery-related claims should be submitted within 72 hours, and damage noticed upon delivery within 5 calendar days. Please keep the item and packaging and wait for the instructions before sending anything back.
